messages:
incident-bot: Paging: SEV2 - Redwood API latency spike in us-west-2. Triggered at 07:47 UTC. Pager: @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall (Sam): I’m on it. Seeing elevated p95 and some 500s from the gateway. I’ll start triage.

maya (prod-eng): Thanks Sam. If you want me to draft a status page initial update, I can.

sre-oncall (Sam): Please — we need something public ASAP (initial + a short mitigation note). I’ll post a short internal update after we have root cause direction.

jamie (inccomm): I can review and publish. Keep it concise: impact, affected customers, mitigation in progress, ETA if possible. Use the template below.

elena (support): Heads up — we already have a couple of inbound tickets. If we publish the page, I’ll send the canned note to active POCs.

maya (prod-eng): Drafting initial status page now. Suggest message: ```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers in us-west-2 may experience increased latency and intermittent errors when calling the Redwood API (generation / embeddings).
Start time: 2026-03-15T07:47:00Z
Scope: A subset of requests routed through the us-west-2 gateway. Not all customers are affected.
What we’re doing: Our on-call and platform teams are actively investigating. We’ve started rolling a routing fallback and are monitoring for reduction in error rates.
Next update: within 30 minutes
```

sre-oncall (Sam): Nice. Two small edits: change "rolling a routing fallback" -> "rolling routing fallback to alternate region for affected requests" and add "No data loss is expected."

maya (prod-eng): Updated: ```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers in us-west-2 may experience increased latency and intermittent 5xx errors for API calls (generation & embeddings).
Start time: 2026-03-15T07:47:00Z
Scope: A subset of requests routed via the us-west-2 gateway. Not all customers affected.
What we’re doing: On-call and platform teams are actively investigating. We have started rolling a routing fallback to an alternate region for affected requests; monitoring for error rate reduction. No data loss is expected.
Next update: within 30 minutes
```

jamie (inccomm): LGTM. I’ll publish. Who’s going to post the internal blurb to #general / #support?

elena (support): I’ll post a short note in #support and notify any POCs with open tickets. Please include a one-paragraph internal summary we can paste.

maya (prod-eng): Internal summary draft: "We’re seeing elevated latency and intermittent 5xxs for some traffic in us-west-2. Teams are deploying a routing fallback to an alternate region; we expect to see improvements within minutes of the change. No data loss reported. On-call is leading mitigation; platform is rolling the fallback. Support will notify customers with active incidents."

ops (pager): change executed: routing fallback began at 07:54 UTC. Observability shows immediate drop in error rate but p95 still elevated.

sre-oncall (Sam): Posting periodic update to status page draft: ```
Update 1 (07:54 UTC): We initiated a routing fallback to an alternate region for affected traffic. Initial metrics show reduced 5xx counts; p95 latency remains elevated. Teams continue to investigate root cause (gateway connection handling). Next update: 15 minutes.
```

jamie (inccomm): Published the initial update + update 1. Status page link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/USW2-latency-1770123456 (placeholder). I also pushed the internal note to #incident-ops. :white_check_mark:

elena (support): Sent canned customer note to active POCs — included status page link, short summary, and expected next update window.

maya (prod-eng): Can we add a short operator-facing play for the postmortem? I’ll add a one-line ask in the status page: "We will follow up with a post-incident report including timeline and mitigation details."

jamie (inccomm): Good call. I added that to the next update.

--- 15 minutes later ---

ops (pager): routing rollback attempt queued at 08:12 UTC after config tweak; rollback held due to warmup considerations.

sre-oncall (Sam): Rolling periodic update: ```
Update 2 (08:12 UTC): Error rates have continued to decline after fallback. We are performing controlled configuration validation before a full rollback. No data loss has been detected. Support contacted customers with ongoing tickets. Next update: 30 minutes or upon significant change.
```

jamie (inccomm): Posted update 2 and added a short FAQ line in the status page: "Which customers are affected? — A subset of requests in us-west-2; customers on Dedicated with regional pinning may not be rerouted."

elena (support): Adding note: for any customer asking about SLAs, escalate to the incidents queue; don’t promise credits until postmortem.

maya (prod-eng): Root cause hypothesis: gateway connection pooling regression after a recent patch to connection handoff logic. I’ll open an RFC and attach links once triage confirms.

ops (pager): Observability: 5xx count down 85% from peak; p95 down 40% but still 2x normal.

sre-oncall (Sam): If metrics stay stable at this level for 30m, we can mark "Monitoring" then "Resolved" after full rollback.

--- 45 minutes later ---

ops (pager): rollback completed at 08:55 UTC; metrics returned to baseline by 09:02 UTC.

sre-oncall (Sam): Drafting resolved status page notice: ```
Status: Resolved
Impact: Several customers in us-west-2 experienced increased latency and intermittent 5xx errors between 07:47 UTC and 09:02 UTC.
Resolution: A routing fallback and subsequent configuration rollback resolved the elevated error rates. No data loss reported.
Follow-up: We will publish a post-incident report (timeline, root cause, remediation) within 72 hours.
```

jamie (inccomm): I’ll publish the resolved notice now and send the short customer-facing resolved email to POCs.

elena (support): Sent resolved emails to the POCs and marked open tickets with the status page link.

maya (prod-eng): Filing the postmortem RFC and assigning to oncall + platform for a deeper RCA. I’ll add proposed remediation (revert/regression test for connection handoff, better canary for gateway patching).

sre-oncall (Sam): Closing loop in thread. Thanks team. If anyone has follow-ups (alerts to tune, runbooks to update), drop them here or open a follow-up issue. :thanks:
